about.title: About Me
about.text_short: Data Scientist with a solid background in Biotechnology. After 4 years managing large-scale data in research (Germany and Spain), I apply data engineering and Machine Learning to solve strategic business problems.
about.text_long: I define myself as a scientist who discovered his true calling in the data behind biology. My journey began in high-level research laboratories (CSIC-UAM, Universität Konstanz), where I learned that data integrity and reproducibility are non-negotiable. Managing terabytes of information in HPC environments taught me to separate signal from noise and to optimize complex pipelines. Recently, I formalized my transition to the tech sector with a Master's in Data Science & AI, applying the same analytical rigor to predictive models, time series, and strategic visualization for decision-making.

items.description: End-to-end development of a demand forecasting system for the retail sector. Implementation of Machine Learning models for sales prediction, customer segmentation, and creation of interactive dashboards for strategic decision-making. The project covered the entire data lifecycle: from ingesting 5 years of bi-yearly transactions to model deployment.
achievements: Processing and cleaning of a dataset with >3000 products and >500K transactions.
Implementation of Lasso Regression for forecasting and K-Means segmentation (6 clusters).
Designed an executive dashboard in Power BI for inventory control.

items.company: Severo Ochoa Center for Molecular Biology (CSIC-UAM)
items.description: Led the computational strategy of the lab. Designed and implemented automated pipelines in Python and Bash for massive data processing (>1TB). Mentored team members, managed budgets with external vendors (Novogene, Illumina), and resolved data crises.
achievements: Supervised and mentored 8 junior researchers (Undergraduate Thesis, Master's Thesis, technicians).
Optimized computational processes using GNU Parallel, drastically reducing processing times.
Successfully rescued a failed genomic dataset (ONT) through a hybrid strategy with Illumina sequencing.
Key contributor to 3 peer-reviewed scientific publications.

items.description: Comprehensive management of the environmental data lifecycle. Responsible for experimental design, data collection in bioreactors, and multivariate statistical analysis. Intensive computational work using queueing systems (Slurm) on high-performance computing (HPC) clusters.
achievements: De novo assembly of eukaryotic transcriptomes from environmental samples.
Multivariate statistical analysis of communities in oligotrophic ecosystems.
Supervised students and managed international purchases of laboratory materials.

items.description: Rigorous data quality evaluation for search and computer vision algorithms. Generation of strict 'Ground Truth' based on complex guidelines to fine-tune Artificial Intelligence models using RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
achievements: Quality assurance for predictive and recommendation models.
Meticulous analytical documentation for continuous improvement of algorithmic precision.

items.title: DSMarket: Retail Forecasting System
items.description: Complete development of a demand prediction system for the retail sector. Integration, cleaning, and transformation of historical data (5 years, 500K+ transactions). Advanced customer segmentation using K-Means and predictive models (Lasso Regression) for sales forecasting. Includes an interactive executive dashboard with business KPIs.

items.title: Genomic Refinement & Data Rescue
items.description: Computational analysis of Ribo-Seq data to redefine genomic annotations in Leishmania. Faced with a dataset degraded by faulty hardware (Nanopore ONT), I designed a hybrid strategy ('Data Rescue') using high-fidelity Illumina sequences to correct the transcriptome, saving the project. Developed optimized scripts with GNU Parallel.
highlights: Drastic optimization of computation times through parallel processing.
Successful recovery of a high-cost failed experiment.

items.title: Environmental Transcriptomics in Aquatic Ecosystems
items.description: Management of large-scale sequencing data at the University of Konstanz. Data processing on high-performance computing (HPC) clusters using queueing systems (Slurm). De novo assembly and multivariate statistical analysis of microbial communities.
highlights: Efficient management of limited computational resources through hybrid workflows (Local/HPC).

items.name: No-Code Automation Hackathon Madrid
items.description: We designed and developed an intelligent assistant for urban parking management. We built an automated flow that cross-referenced the vehicle's license plate and environmental label with the user's real-time GPS location. The chatbot determined if the user could park in that zone and, in case of restrictions, orchestrated a response recommending and sending the route to the nearest legal parking.

items.name: Sextant.ai - Intelligent Travel Planner
items.description: Intelligent application for generating highly personalized travel itineraries. The architecture connects a Django frontend with a backend orchestrated by LLMs. The system processes user preferences to structure a complete trip: it generates a main itinerary, dynamically breaks it down into daily plans, and enriches the experience by injecting cultural and historical information specific to each location.
